english.title: Permit inflammable / explosive / corrosive gas / petrol / spirit / substance / matter to remain on the Midland Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted

(A)_[an inflammable]_
(B)_[an explosive]_
(C)_[a corrosive]_

(D)_[gas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GAS..),]_
(E)_[petrol or spirit, namely **(..SPECIFY PETROL OR TYPE OF SPIRIT..),]_
(F)_[liquid substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF SUBSTANCE..),]_
(G)_[matter, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF MATTER..),]_

which was or may have become dangerous or harmful to any persons or property, to remain on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(3)(ii) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
